kitEvidence.formula:
First Cast: Hurl a needle that deals [30 / 50 / 70 + (0.1) × AP] magic damage, Slows by [(-0.4 / -0.5 / -0.6) × -100]% for [1.5] seconds, and applies A Thousand Cuts to all enemies hit. Gwen can Recast this ability up to 2 additional times within 6 seconds ([1]s cooldown between casts).

Second Cast: Fire three needles to deal [(30 / 50 / 70 + (0.1) × AP) × (3)] magic damage
Third Cast: Fire five needles to deal [(30 / 50 / 70 + (0.1) × AP) × (5)] magic damage
